name: Bright Needle
description: Narrow soul force to a bright thread and prick it into the target's mind so a sharp ache breaks their focus.

name: Thread Guard
description: Hold a fine screen of soul force before the mind to turn aside a stabbing probe from another soul.

name: Needle Count
description: Send a faint needle outward and read from its return how strong the nearest soul stands.

name: Pinprick Chain
description: Land three quick pricks of soul force on one foe in a row so the small pains pile into a flinch.

name: Dull Eye
description: Press a pinch of soul force against the target's focus so their next move comes a breath too late.

name: Lance Thrust
description: Gather soul force into a long lance and drive it straight into the target's mind through their guard of will.

name: Couched Charge
description: Brace the soul behind a levelled lance and rush it forward so the full weight lands on one foe.

name: Shaft Parry
description: Meet an incoming soul strike with the lance shaft and knock it wide before it reaches the mind.

name: Reach Measure
description: Hold the lance out without striking and feel how far it runs before it brushes another soul.

name: Shaft Grip
description: Close the will around the lance shaft to steady every thrust so the aim does not waver.

name: Tip Flick
description: Whip the lance tip sideways across the target's focus to spoil a technique that is half formed.

name: Hushed Blow
description: Strike the target's soul with no wind-up and no sign so the blow lands before the hand is seen.

name: Silent Rap
description: Knock once on the target's will with a short dry beat of soul force that rattles their nerve.

name: Muffled Guard
description: Wrap the soul in a thick quiet layer that deadens a soul strike before it can ring.

name: Still Listen
description: Hold the soul perfectly still and listen for the faint stir of any soul that draws near.

name: Unseen Hand
description: Slip a thin pressure of soul force into the target's rhythm so their breath and their guard fall out of step.

name: Quiet Weight
description: Settle the user's own will into a heavy calm so the next soul strike carries more force for the same effort.

name: Mallet Blow
description: Swing a blunt mass of soul force down on the target's head and shake the thoughts out of order.

name: Heavy Knock
description: Drive a short hard knock of soul force into one foe and leave a dull ache behind the eyes.

name: Ringing Head
description: Strike so the target's thoughts ring like a struck bell and no clear plan can form for a moment.

name: Dizzy Tap
description: Tap the target's sense of direction with soul force until up and down swap places for a breath.

name: Hammer Guard
description: Harden the will like an anvil face so a heavy soul blow rings off it without sinking in.

name: Haft Steady
description: Steady the grip of will on the hammer so each blow lands square and wastes none of its weight.

name: Anvil Sense
description: Rap lightly on a soul and judge from the dullness or ring of the answer how well it is guarded.

name: Sharp Twinge
description: Stab a bright twinge of soul pain straight through the target's guard to a single nerve of will.

name: Flinch Jab
description: Jab at the target's calm to force a flinch and break the rhythm of their guard.

name: Aching Prod
description: Prod the target's soul again and again with a dull pain that builds with each touch.

name: Numb Cloak
description: Draw a numbing cloak of soul force round the user so incoming soul pain is dulled to a murmur.

name: Pain Reading
description: Touch a soul with a feather of force and read from its wince where it is most easily hurt.

name: Thin Cut
description: Slice across the target's will with a thin edge of soul force that leaves the body unmarked.

name: Hairline
description: Slide an edge no thicker than a hair through a gap in the target's guard of will.

name: Edge Turning
description: Angle the soul so a cutting strike slides along it and past instead of biting in.

name: Honing Breath
description: Breathe slowly while drawing soul force thin so that the next cut runs sharper for the same cost.

name: Edge Feel
description: Run the soul's edge lightly along a foe's will to find where it is thin and where it is thick.

name: Whisper Cut
description: Cut a single thread of the target's concentration so a half drawn technique goes slack.

name: Gathered Point
description: Pull all the will to one point and loose it at a single weak spot in the target's soul.

name: Tight Beam
description: Squeeze soul force into a tight beam that pierces a guard where a wide blow would spread and fail.

name: Narrow Stab
description: Stab with all the will behind a very small mark so a weak soul still lands a hard blow.

name: Will Gather
description: Draw scattered will into the centre of the soul and hold it ready so the next strike carries all of it.

name: Pinned Ward
description: Gather the will onto the spot an attack is aimed at and harden only that spot against the blow.

name: Aim Check
description: Hold the gathered force still and confirm it is truly centred on the mark before loosing it.

name: Stored Release
description: Loose the stored will all at once onto the target's focus and wipe the thought they were forming.

name: Gentle Prick
description: Touch the target's soul with a small careful prick that stings without straining the fragile new soul.

name: Soft Barrier
description: Spread a soft barrier of soul force close round the young soul to catch a probing touch.

name: Waking Sense
description: Feel outward with the new soul and note which nearby souls are watching and which are asleep.

name: Light Rebuke
description: Push back a pressing soul with a light shove that leaves it startled and a step away.

name: Careful Draw
description: Draw soul force slowly and in small measures so the young soul gains strength without tearing.

name: Fragile Guard
description: Tilt the whole soul away from a strike so the blow glances off and spends itself elsewhere.
